pattern: named repo of a multi-repo thread looked up instead of read from the repo list
experience: In a project that also tracks a separate api checkout, the agent was asked about 'the api repo' but had no list of the thread's repositories, so it searched the disk or asked where the checkout was before it could run git there.
rule: Each Git repository has its own history and branches. Run Git commands inside the repository that you change.

world.otherFolders: /home/user/acme-api is a separate git checkout of github.com/acme/api on main. In it, git status --short prints ' M src/routes/users.ts' and '?? src/routes/teams.ts'. /home/user/notes/design is a plain folder, not a git repo, with spec.md in it. The working directory has no uncommitted changes.

prompt: Which files have uncommitted changes in the api repo?
